name: orgloom-vscode
description: A canvas for Salesforce records in VS Code. Explore, edit, create, and share records in one workspace. Prepare changes, collaborate with teammates, and upload when you’re ready.

orgloom.localRecovery.enabled.description: Save encrypted canvas recovery copies on this computer. Keys are stored in VS Code SecretStorage. Disabling this deletes existing recovery copies and keys for all Org Loom connections on this computer without closing your current canvas.

commands.title: Org Loom: Connect with Salesforce CLI
